title: Go-Go Town! – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
description: Go-Go Town! – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition upgrades Prideful Sloth’s town-building simulation for newer hardware. Nintendo specifically lists enhanced resolution at 1080p, a higher frame rate of 60 fps, and enhanced visuals. The game retains local and online two-player co-op and the full mayor-driven building and logistics loop.
